subject: Media Literacy
title: Targeted Advertising and Manipulation
description: A quick win: understand Targeted Advertising and Manipulation.

hook.text: An ad for gambling appeared during a recovering addict's most vulnerable hours. The algorithm knew exactly when to strike.

buildup.text: Targeted advertising uses personal data to deliver ads matched to individual vulnerabilities, needs, and desires.

discovery.text: Platforms can target people by emotional state, life events, financial stress, or health conditions — all from behavioral data.

twist.text: This isn't advertising. It's psychological targeting — exploiting individual weaknesses identified through surveillance.

climax.text: When an ad knows your fears, insecurities, and vulnerabilities, it's no longer persuasion. It's manipulation.

punchline.text: The ad didn't find you by chance. It found you by data.

quiz.question: How does targeted advertising cross into manipulation?
options: By exploiting individual vulnerabilities identified through behavioral surveillance data
It doesn't — all targeting is harmless
